title: [Quality Management] Enable Bin code selection for transfer disposition in workflow response
summary: Bin code selection is now available for transfer disposition in workflow responses for quality inspections, matching the behavior of the manual disposition form.
key_points: Workflow response options for transfer disposition now let you choose a bin code
Behaviour now matches the manual quality inspection disposition form
Change is limited to the Qlty. Workflow Resp. Options page extension
quote: Synchronize behavior with manual disposition form quality inspection.
